core_obligations: Prove the image is contained in the subsheaf: the presheaf map constructed in the etale cohomology lemma has image clearly contained in the subsheaf of lemma-f-shriek-separated, and sheafification preserves the containment (proof lines 431-441).

Prove the converse: for a section s of j_*F over V with support Z proper over V, note Z is finite with closed image Z' by the characterization of finite morphisms and s vanishes over V minus Z' (proof lines 441-446).

Conclude etale-locally: decompose U over an etale neighbourhood into opens isomorphic to the base, pull s back along the inverse isomorphisms to obtain the formal sum in j_{p!}F mapping to the restriction of s, so s is etale locally in the image (proof lines 447-463).
proof_roadmap: Containment via the presheaf construction and sheafification (proof lines 431-441).
Support is finite with closed image (proof lines 441-446).
Etale-local lifting through the decomposition (proof lines 447-463).
